scope: PD/drone target candidates, AI observed-missile threats, dominated sensor-ray rejection and exact shared terrain-exposure samples. Original ordering, live damage checks, observations, 60Hz/240Hz and ship data retained.
limitations: Scale cases are synthetic Earth/Earth in one shared SimWorld, 40km start. They do not establish 240-ship rendered multiplayer FPS.
Main sizes use three isolated before/after repetitions with alternating order; extended asteroid seed2 and late 180-240s cases each use one before/after pair.
The fresh six-run native FPS set measures the standard 24-ship scene at 4x simulation speed, not 240 ships. Release before/after cases are consecutive but single pairs.
Native Debug has optimized Sim but unoptimized game/view; actual JIT flags are stored with every FPS log.
The six-job 240-battle matrix validates behavior only, not performance. Navigation comparison excludes nondeterministic buildMs/planMs only.
Development-only detail/pd/trial/drone/terrain-trial measurements and the defense-only directory precede the final sensor/terrain changes; they do not feed the final tables.
Other hardware, large multiplayer networking/render/audio load, longer battles, other large-scene design mixes and manual play feel remain unverified.
